name: todogit
description: Git Project Manager — root scripts; each package keeps its own pnpm lockfile

scripts.test: pnpm -C backend test && pnpm -C frontend test
scripts.test:coverage: pnpm -C backend test:coverage && pnpm -C frontend test:coverage
scripts.lint: pnpm -C backend lint && pnpm -C frontend lint
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C backend typecheck && pnpm -C frontend typecheck
